correctionOf.defect: the binary cells were fitted three-wide, because fit_softmax sized its matrix from len(CLASSES) == 3 while the k argument only sized majorityClass and predictedMix. A third logit trained on no target row, and predictedMix was keyed 0/1 for those cells while the three-class cells were keyed 0/1/2.
correctionOf.scope: output dimension and reported class names only. Rows, features, splits, seeds, preprocessing and every reported metric are unchanged, and the three-class cells still fit CLASSES exactly as before; their numbers are expected to be identical to v1.
correctionOf.exposure: this artifact is an in-sample diagnostic already examined in v1; the holdout periods used against it were examined too. Nothing here is a new independent result.

what: in-sample fits, deliberately optimistic; a floor on what is findable, never a performance estimate
verdict: the features separate the classes in-sample by more than this model extracts from shuffled labels, so signal exists and the failure is generalisation
notAnEvaluation: no holdout is involved; none of these numbers may be reported as performance
